# Packages and Functions
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
plot_loadings <- function(L_est, Pop, legendYN = TRUE, scales_option = "fixed"){
  # options for scales_option are "fixed" and "free_y"
  n <- nrow(L_est)
  k <- ncol(L_est)
  Idx <- rep(c(1:n), k)
  Loading <- c(L_est)
  Factor <- paste0('k=',c(sapply(c(1:k), function(x, n){rep(x, n)}, n = n)))
  tib <- data.frame(Idx, Loading, Factor, Pop)
  plt <- ggplot(tib, aes(x = Idx, y = Loading, col = Pop)) +
    geom_point(show.legend = legendYN) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(Factor), scales = scales_option) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"))
  plot(plt)
}

plot_heatmap <- function(L, title = "", colors_range = c("gray96", "red"), brks = NULL){
  ### define the color map
  cols <- colorRampPalette(colors_range)(49)
  if (is.null(brks) == TRUE){
    brks <- seq(min(L), max(L), length=50)
  }
  
  plt <- pheatmap(L, show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, color = cols, breaks = brks, main = title)
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r}
dscout <- readRDS("dsc_results.rds")
dscout2 <- readRDS("dsc_diff_n_p_results.rds")
```

colnames(dscout)

# Dataframe Cleaning
## n less than p
```{r}
# change NA to no split in datasplit column
dscout$data_split[is.na(dscout$data_split) == TRUE] <- 'None'
```

```{r}
dscout$analyze_col_split_only[dscout$analyze_col_split_only == 'symebcovmf'] <- 'ebcd_direct'
```

```{r}
# create one column for analysis method
dscout <- dscout %>% mutate(analyze = coalesce(analyze_col_split_only, analyze_col_and_row_split))

# change NA to PCA in analyze column
dscout$analyze[is.na(dscout$analyze) == TRUE] <- 'PCA'
```

```{r}
dscout$init[is.na(dscout$init) == TRUE & dscout$analyze != 'PCA'] <- 'true_init'
```

```{r}
# create one column for prior
dscout <- dscout %>% mutate(prior = coalesce(analyze_col_and_row_split.ebnm_fn, analyze_col_split_only.ebnm_fn))

# reformat the priors to only contain the prior name
dscout$prior <- sub("^.*?_", "", dscout$prior)
```

```{r}
dscout <- dscout |> mutate(simulate_setting = paste(simulate, coalesce(simulate.pop_sizes, as.character(simulate.pi0)), sep = '-'))

dscout <- dscout |> mutate(simulate_setting = case_match(simulate_setting,
    "baltree_4pop-rep(40, 4)" ~ 'Balanced Tree - Balanced Groups',
    "baltree_4pop-c(20,50,30,60)" ~ 'Balanced Tree - Unbalanced Groups',
    "group_overlap-0.1" ~ 'Sparse Overlap - 0.1',
    "group_overlap-0.3" ~ 'Sparse Overlap - 0.3',
    "group_nonoverlap-rep(40, 4)" ~ 'Balanced Nonoverlap',
    "group_nonoverlap-c(20,50,30,60)" ~ 'Unbalanced Nonoverlap',
    "unbaltree_4pop-rep(40, 4)" ~ 'Unbalanced Tree',
    .default = NA  # Optional: handles unexpected values
  ))

dscout$simulate_setting <- factor(dscout$simulate_setting, levels = c('Unbalanced Nonoverlap','Balanced Nonoverlap', 'Sparse Overlap - 0.1', 'Sparse Overlap - 0.3', 'Balanced Tree - Balanced Groups','Balanced Tree - Unbalanced Groups','Unbalanced Tree'))
```

```{r}
dscout <- dscout |> mutate(init = case_match(init,
    "pt_laplace_split" ~ 'Point-Laplace EBcovMF with splitting',
    "codesymnmf_init" ~ 'CoDesymNMF Initialization',
    "ebmfcov_greedy" ~ 'EBcovMF Greedy',
    "ebmfcov_greedy_refit" ~ 'EBcovMF Greedy with refitting',
    "true_init" ~ 'True Init',
    .default = NA  # Optional: handles unexpected values
  ))
```

```{r}
# I also want to make new columns which capture the analysis method information
dscout <- dscout |> mutate(method = paste0(analyze, ifelse(is.na(prior), '', 
                                                           paste0('-', ifelse(prior == 'point_exponential', 'pt-exp', 'gb')))))
```

```{r}
# change NA to no split in datasplit column
dscout$score[is.na(dscout$score) == TRUE] <- 'obj_func_val'
```

```{r}
dscout <- dscout |> mutate(metric_value = coalesce(score.result, score_no_split.result))
```

# Stability Selection

## n less than p
```{r}
# row-split vs column split for n < p

# let's filter the data to get rid of anything we don't need
dscout_stability_selection_plot1 <- dscout |> 
  filter(data_split != 'None', score %in% c('prop_est_high_cos_sim','prop_true_high_cos_sim')) |>
  mutate(data_split = case_match(data_split,
    "rand_split_by_col" ~ 'column',
    "rand_split_by_row" ~ 'row'
  ))

# I'll also make some choices on what versions of the methods we will consider
dscout_stability_selection_plot1 <- dscout_stability_selection_plot1 |>
  filter(is.na(row_split_estimate_L) == TRUE | row_split_estimate_L == 'backfit_L') |>
  filter(score.sim_threshold == 0.90) |>
  filter(stability_selection.threshold == 0.8) |>
  filter(prior == 'point_exponential') |>
  filter(analyze %in% c('simplified_gbcd','ebcd')) |>
  select(simulate_setting, data_split, init, analyze, prior, method, score, score.result)
```

```{r}
dscout_stability_selection_aggregate_values_plot1 <- dscout_stability_selection_plot1 |>
  group_by(simulate_setting, init, data_split, method, score) |>
  summarise(mean_score_result = mean(score.result))

stability_selection_plot1_df <- dscout_stability_selection_aggregate_values_plot1 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = score,   # column containing the names: e.g. "metric_1", "metric_2"
    values_from = mean_score_result   # column containing the numerical scores
  )
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(stability_selection_plot1_df, aes(x = prop_est_high_cos_sim, y = prop_true_high_cos_sim, color = method, shape = data_split)) +
  # Points with stroke thickness for crisp open circle borders
  geom_point(size = 2.4, stroke = 1) +
  # 7 rows (setting) by 4 columns (init)
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(simulate_setting),
    cols = vars(init),
    labeller = labeller(
    simulate_setting = label_wrap_gen(width = 15))
  ) +
  # Explicitly map versions to filled (16) and open (1) circles
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("column" = 16, "row" = 1)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # Axis limits [0, 1]
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Row-split vs Column-split Stability Selection Across Different Settings (n < p)",
    x = "Precision",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    color = "Method",
    shape = "Split Type"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey93", color = "grey60"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p)
```

## stability selection vs no stability selection
```{r}
# let's filter the data to get rid of anything we don't need
dscout_stability_selection_plot3 <- dscout |> 
  filter(data_split != 'rand_split_by_row', score %in% c('prop_est_high_cos_sim','prop_true_high_cos_sim'), init != 'True Init', analyze != 'PCA') |>
  mutate(data_split = case_match(data_split,
    "rand_split_by_col" ~ 'column',
    "None" ~ 'no split'
  ))

# I'll also make some choices on what versions of the methods we will consider
dscout_stability_selection_plot3 <- dscout_stability_selection_plot3 |>
  filter(score.sim_threshold == 0.90) |>
  filter(stability_selection.threshold == 0.8 | is.na(stability_selection.threshold) == TRUE) |>
  filter(prior == 'point_exponential' | is.na(prior) == TRUE) |>
  select(simulate_setting, data_split, init, analyze, prior, method, score, score.result) 
```

```{r}
dscout_stability_selection_aggregate_values_plot3 <- dscout_stability_selection_plot3 |>
  group_by(simulate_setting, init, data_split, method, score) |>
  summarise(mean_score_result = mean(score.result))

stability_selection_plot3_df <- dscout_stability_selection_aggregate_values_plot3 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = score,   # column containing the names: e.g. "metric_1", "metric_2"
    values_from = mean_score_result   # column containing the numerical scores
  )
```

```{r}
p3 <- ggplot(stability_selection_plot3_df, aes(x = prop_est_high_cos_sim, y = prop_true_high_cos_sim, color = method, shape = data_split)) +
  # Points with stroke thickness for crisp open circle borders
  geom_point(size = 2.4, stroke = 1) +
  # 7 rows (setting) by 4 columns (init)
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(simulate_setting),
    cols = vars(init),
    labeller = labeller(
    simulate_setting = label_wrap_gen(width = 15))
  ) +
  # Explicitly map versions to filled (16) and open (1) circles
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("column" = 16, "no split" = 1),
    breaks = c("column", "no split"),
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(
    palette = "Set1",
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  # Axis limits [0, 1]
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Stability Selection vs. No Stability Across Different Settings",
    x = "Precision",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    color = "Method",
    shape = "Split Type"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey93", color = "grey60"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p3)
```

### Change in sensitivity vs change in specificity

```{r}
stability_selection_plot3_df$data_split[stability_selection_plot3_df$data_split == 'no split'] <- 'no_split'

stability_selection_diff_plot3_df <- stability_selection_plot3_df |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = data_split,   # column containing the names: e.g. "metric_1", "metric_2"
    values_from = c(prop_est_high_cos_sim, prop_true_high_cos_sim)   # column containing the numerical scores
  ) |>
  mutate(diff_prop_est_high_cos_sim = prop_est_high_cos_sim_column - prop_est_high_cos_sim_no_split,
         diff_prop_true_high_cos_sim = prop_true_high_cos_sim_column - prop_true_high_cos_sim_no_split)
```

```{r}
p4 <- ggplot(stability_selection_diff_plot3_df, aes(x = diff_prop_est_high_cos_sim, y = diff_prop_true_high_cos_sim, color = method)) +
  # Points with stroke thickness for crisp open circle borders
  geom_point(size = 2.4, stroke = 1) +
  # 7 rows (setting) by 4 columns (init)
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(simulate_setting),
    cols = vars(init),
    labeller = labeller(
    simulate_setting = label_wrap_gen(width = 15))
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(
    palette = "Set1",
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  # Axis limits [0, 1]
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Metrics for Stability Selection vs. No Stability Selection",
    x = "Change in Precision",
    y = "Change in Sensitivity",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey93", color = "grey60"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p4)
```

# Unbalanced Nonoverlapping

```{r}
dscout_unbal_nonoverlap_results <- dscout |>
  filter(simulate_setting == 'Unbalanced Nonoverlap') |>
  filter(data_split == 'rand_split_by_col') |>
  filter(stability_selection.threshold == 0.8) |>
  filter(score %in% c('cov_L2_fit','prop_true_high_cos_sim')) |>
  filter(score.sim_threshold == 0.9 | is.na(score.sim_threshold) == TRUE) |>
  tidyr::unnest(score.result) |>
  select(init, analyze, prior, score, score.result)
```

```{r}
dscout_unbal_nonoverlap_sensitivity <- dscout_unbal_nonoverlap_results |>
  filter(score == 'prop_true_high_cos_sim')
```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(data = dscout_unbal_nonoverlap_sensitivity, aes(x = analyze, y = score.result, color = prior))  +
  facet_wrap(vars(init), scales = "fixed") +
  geom_boxplot() + theme(
    # Rotate labels 45 degrees
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = 'bottom'
  ) + labs(title = "Sensitivity for Unbalanced Nonoverlapping",
       x = "Method",
       y = "Sensitivity (Threshold of 0.90)") +
  ylim(0,1)

p1
```

```{r}
dscout_unbal_nonoverlap_recon_error <- dscout_unbal_nonoverlap_results |>
  filter(score == 'cov_L2_fit')
```

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(data = dscout_unbal_nonoverlap_recon_error, aes(x = analyze, y = score.result, color = prior))  +
  facet_wrap(vars(init), scales = "fixed") +
  geom_boxplot() + theme(
    # Rotate labels 45 degrees
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = 'bottom'
  ) + labs(title = "Reconstruction Error for Unbalanced Nonoverlapping",
       x = "Method",
       y = "Reconstruction Error")

p2
```
